items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: we used to call him Scotty -- I can't remember what his first name was.

ctx.x: But I just couldn't... I never have been able to understand how he could do this, and come up with good arrangements, and no piano, nothing. He was a trombone player. Although he did play piano. He could play the piano, and he knew the piano well. But he only used it for arranging. A couple of times I heard him play a few things. As a matter of fact, I think he played piano with a group in Chicago, a small group, Dallas Bartley's band I think he played with, a guy that was formerly with Louis Jordan.

But to get back to the band. Jerry Valentine was a trombone player. And there was another r young fellow there, we used to call him Scotty -- I can't remember what his first name was. I think his last name was Scott, which is the reason why they called him Scotty.
